annotations.destructiveHintJustification: Not destructive: checking a code cannot delete, overwrite, or irreversibly change any data, account, order, or external state.
annotations.idempotentHintJustification: Idempotent: repeating the same check returns the same stored record and changes nothing — the record changes only through separate verification runs and report_outcome telemetry, never through a check.
annotations.openWorldHintJustification: Not open-world: the answer comes only from MasaDeals' own bounded, checkout-tested dataset — the tool performs no web search or browsing and reaches no arbitrary external system.
annotations.readOnlyHintJustification: Read-only: the call only reads the stored record for one code — its status, constraints, and success stats — and returns it; it creates, changes, and deletes nothing.

annotations.title: Find Codes

description: Find promo codes that fit this cart, ranked by verified checkout success only. Coverage (Nov 20, 2026): live guest-cart test results for 20 merchants — Adidas, Best Buy, Chewy, CVS Photo, Dick's Sporting Goods, Fanatics, Home Depot, Kohl's, Macy's, Michaels, Nike, Nordstrom, Sephora, Staples, Target, Ulta Beauty, Under Armour, Walmart, Wayfair, Zappos. 220 codes tested; 14 currently verified across Adidas, Chewy, Home Depot, Kohl's, Michaels, Staples, and CVS Photo. For a covered merchant with no working code, the verdict is 'no_verified_code' with that merchant's dated test record — a certified negative. The service also holds merchant-published savings facts for the same 20 merchants (82 facts: shipping thresholds, membership discounts, price-match policies, live sales), served in merchant detail responses. Merchants outside the covered set return 'merchant_not_found'.

cart.description: The actual cart context — constraints are checked against it

customer_type.description: Shopper type: 'any' (default), 'new' or 'returning' — some codes are new-customer only

items.description: Optional line items for cart-precise matching; each item may carry its category and price

price.description: Line item price in the merchant's currency

total.description: Cart subtotal in the merchant's currency

title: Find Codes

annotations.destructiveHintJustification: Not destructive: recording an outcome only appends telemetry — it never deletes or overwrites existing records, and it changes nothing at any merchant (no orders, accounts, payments, or cancellations).
annotations.idempotentHintJustification: Not idempotent: each call appends a new checkout-outcome event, so repeating a call records the outcome again — report each real checkout attempt exactly once.
annotations.openWorldHintJustification: Not open-world: the write goes only to MasaDeals' own telemetry store; the tool contacts no external system and takes no action on the public internet.
annotations.readOnlyHintJustification: Not read-only: the call appends one checkout-outcome event to MasaDeals' own telemetry store, updating the code's success statistics — that is why readOnlyHint is false.
annotations.title: Report Outcome

description: Report what happened when a code was tried at checkout. This telemetry is what keeps the feed verified — free-tier callers must report outcomes.

applied.description: true if the code applied successfully

code.description: The promo code that was tried at checkout

failure_reason.description: Why the code did not apply (report when applied is false): expired, min_not_met, geo, category, customer_type, not_stackable, single_use_exhausted, code_rejected, other

name: report_outcome
title: Report Outcome
